   HOMŒOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA

         by William BOERICKE, M.D.

          Presented by Médi-T



           THIOSINAMINUM

         A Chemical Derived from Oil of Mustard-seed

        (RHODALLIN)


Are solvent, externally and internally, for   dissolving
        scar tissue  , tumors, enlarged glands; lupus, strictures, adhesions. Ectropion,
        opacities of cornea, cataract, ankylosis, fibroids, scleroderma. Noises in ear. Suggested by
        Dr. A. S. Hard for retarding old age. A remedy for Tabes dorsalis, improving the lightning
        pains. Gastric, vesicle and rectal crises. Stricture of rectum, 2 grains twice daily.



Ear.--  Arterio-sclerotic   vertigo.
        Tinnitus  . Catarrhal deafness with cicatricial thickening. Subacute suppurative
        otitis media, formation of fibrous bands impeding free movement of the ossicles. Thickened
        drum. Deafness due to some fibrous change in the nerve.



Dose.--  Inject under skin, or, into the lesion a 10 per cent
        solution in glycerine and water, 15-30 drops twice a week. Internally in capsules 1/2 grain
        daily. Obstinate arterio-sclerotic ailments in doses of 1/2 grain, never more, 3 times a
        day. Vertigo and arthritis (Bartlett). 2x attenuation.
